lines.en: I need to talk to you.
Oh, I'm glad you guys are past that little awkward face.
When you left, she started asking questions about you.
Oh, like what she saw, huh?
Okay, what do you think? You interested at all?
Oh, thank you, Chandler. This is so great. She's going to love me.
Okay, dinosaur attack. Quick, everybody into the house.
